sources.title: Bad Ragaz tourism — Memories restaurant
sources.claim: Memories restaurant is located in the Grand Hotel Quellenhof within the Grand Resort Bad Ragaz.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Sorell Hotel Tamina Garni
sources.claim: Sorell Hotel Tamina is ranked #2 of 7 hotels in Bad Ragaz, rated 4.5/5; rates from ~CHF 174.

sources.title: Kayak — nearby hotels to Grand Resort
sources.claim: Nearby hotels to Grand Resort Bad Ragaz: Esos Hotel Quelle 0.12 mi, Hotel Krone 0.13 mi, Sorell Tamina 0.17 mi, Boutique Hotel Ochsen 0.24 mi.

sources.title: Grand Resort — Inclusive services 2026
sources.claim: From 1 Feb to Dec 2026 the ground floor of Hof Ragaz is under modernization; Memories opens 5 Feb, Wed–Sat 19:00–21:30; inclusive thermal spa, transfer from Bad Ragaz station, Tamina Therme access are part of resort stays.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Grand Resort Bad Ragaz
sources.claim: Grand Resort Bad Ragaz: Tripadvisor #1 of 7 in Bad Ragaz, 4.7/5 from 1,162 reviews; nightly rate $724–$1,470; value 4.4/5.

sources.title: Grand Resort — Hotel Palais Bad Ragaz
sources.claim: Hotel Palais Bad Ragaz is the oldest building of the resort (18th c.), 14 rooms, member of Relais & Châteaux; houses IGNIV and Zollstube.

sources.title: Grand Resort — Rooms & Suites
sources.claim: Grand Resort campus includes Grand Hotel Quellenhof, Spa Suites, Grand Hotel Hof Ragaz, and Hotel Palais Bad Ragaz; Spa Suites are modern with thermal-water access.

sources.title: Grand Resort — Grand Hotel Quellenhof
sources.claim: Grand Hotel Quellenhof has been renovated by architect Claudio Carbone, blending tradition with contemporary style.

sources.title: Boutique Hotel Ochsen Bad Ragaz
sources.claim: Boutique Hotel Ochsen has 17 light-filled rooms at Bartholomépl. 4, 7310 Bad Ragaz, in a fully renovated building.

sources.title: Booking.com — Ochsen Bad Ragaz reviews
sources.claim: Boutique Hotel Ochsen rated 7.3/10 by Booking.com from 1,121 reviews; some guests report street noise from rooms on the main road.

sources.title: Expedia — Hotel Krone by b-smart
sources.claim: Hotel Krone by b-smart is a 3-star self-check-in property with 14 rooms, no on-site parking; rates from $95.

sources.title: Expedia — Esos Hotel Quelle
sources.claim: Esos Hotel Quelle is a 3-star golf hotel in central Bad Ragaz with free breakfast, free WiFi, and free parking.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Hotel Schloss Ragaz
sources.claim: Hotel Schloss Ragaz is a 5-minute walk from Tamina Thermal Baths and roughly 30 minutes from Bad Ragaz station; reviews mixed on cleanliness and bed comfort; avg rate ~$244.
